about_the_game:
The DLC that turns

“Kaitou Tenshi TwinAngel ~Toki to Sekai no Meikyu~ Re:light”, which was released on March 14th, 2025

into a fully voiced game!

Please enjoy the passionate performances of the voice actors who also appeared in the original work.

Important

The update process may take several minutes to 20 minutes, and if you follow the wrong procedure, the data transfer may not be completed successfully. Please be sure to refer to the manual on the right side of the page (URL of the procedure manual is available) before updating.

Story

Haruka Minazuki and Aoi Kannazuki are two ordinary girls who usually attend St. Cherrine School.

However, their secret identities are the heroic Kaitou Tenshi TwinAngels!

During the day, they enjoy their school life, but at night, they fight against a huge conspiracy as angels.

As Hazuki Kurumi grows up, she interacts with Tesla and Nine, who have become her companions through their battles.

Haruka and the others join forces to foil the ambitions of the dark organization “The Black Fund”, but

their joy is short-lived, as the “Tears of the Angels”, the treasure they have just recovered, is stolen again.

In the course of pursuing a new conspiracy, they encounter two mysterious Kaitou Tenshi... ?

The bonds between Haruka and the others, their great exploits, and the reason for the birth of the TwinAngels are revealed.
